method.title: Find stops
method.description: Pick how to find stops. Picked stops are kept, so you can combine methods.

menu_options.nearby: Near a point on the map

nearby.title: Near a point
nearby.description: Pick the point and radius — stops inside the circle will be offered.

address.title: Near an address
address.description: For example “Obchodná 10” or “Ružinov, Bajkalská”. Searched in Slovakia via OpenStreetMap.

search.title: Stop name
search.description: Part of the name, diacritics optional. Several names separated by commas: “hodzovo, postova”.

stops.title: Stops
stops.description: Tick the stops to follow. Already picked stops are at the top.

platforms.title: Platforms
platforms.description: Each platform becomes a sensor. Untick the directions you don't need.

error.cannot_connect: Could not load the stop list.
error.geocode_failed: Address search is unavailable, try again later.
